sources.betti: first 4 H1 Betti-curve fPCA scores (slice_<k>.npz, as section 7)

arms.P: protocol nested arm refitted (density arm + 4 scores, unscaled); gate: equals the saved arm for every seed
arms.Z_density: density arm with a StandardScaler fitted on the outer training fold
arms.Z: nested arm with a StandardScaler fitted on the outer training fold

weight_share: sum over the 4 score columns of |coef_j| * SD_j over the sum over all columns, SD_j the training-fold SD (ddof=0) of the column the classifier sees
intervals: paired bootstrap over slides of seed-averaged per-slide values, shared indices default_rng(12345).integers(0, 123, (4000, 123)); nested: Z - Z_density (accuracy), Z_density - Z (log-loss); scaling_density: Z_density - A
